question:
**Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A person who supports the status quo and is opposed to change**
solution: The correct answer is: **Conservative**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Conservative"** refers to a person who supports traditional practices and resists changes or innovations. (रूढ़िवादी) • **Example:** Many conservative politicians argue against rapid reform in the education system. • **"Liberal"** refers to someone open to new ideas and willing to discard traditional values, especially in political or social matters. (उदारवादी) • **Example:** Liberals advocate for equal rights and freedoms for everyone in society. • **"Reactionary"** indicates someone who strongly opposes progress or change and desires to return to a previous state of society. (प्रतिक्रियावादी) • **Example:** The reactionary group protested against the new laws aiming for social reform. • **"Progressive"** refers to someone who supports social reform or new, innovative changes for society’s betterment. (प्रगतिशील) • **Example:** Progressive thinkers often push for advancements in science and technology to improve human life. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Conservative**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Liberal** (उदारवादी): Someone open to new ideas and willing to discard traditional values. • **Example:** He is a liberal thinker who supports gender equality in all aspects of life. • **Reactionary** (प्रतिक्रियावादी): Someone opposing progress or change and desiring a return to a previous state. • **Example:** The reactionary group resisted adopting modern technology in their workplaces. • **Progressive** (प्रगतिशील): A person who supports innovation and social reform. • **Example:** Progressive leaders often focus on improving the quality of education and healthcare. 4b:Ta3e, The correct answer is: **Option 2 - Astronomer**.
